messages:
lena: Halcyon wants a short POC to prove 600 sustained qps (chat) with p95 < 50ms and graceful handling of 1k qps microbursts. They also need a security Q&A, pricing for reserved vs on-demand, and a runbook. Can we scope?

drew: We can run it on dedicated nodes. Need to pick model + token envelope. What model variant do they expect? Any encryption/KMS constraints?

lena: They indicated open to our redwood-m-8k quantized or a slightly smaller redwood-s-8k if cost matters. Encryption: KMS + VPC; SOC2 evidence requested.

kevin: Draft load/test plan -- propose the following:

```
# POC load/test plan
precondition: cluster provisioned (4xA100), NVMe for KV cache
soak: 90m @ 350 qps (soak to warm caches+observe memory)
ramp: 0 -> 600 qps over 3m
sustain: 10m @ 600 qps
burst-tests: 3x 30s @ 1000 qps spaced during sustain
repeat: run the main test 3 times (after config tweaks)
payload: prompt ~45 tokens, response ~110 tokens, history depth 1, 1 cached prefix
metrics: p50/p90/p95/p99 latency, success rate, queue length, GPU util, batch size distribution, tokens/sec
notes: capture model traces + kernel timings for regressions
```

kevin: Suggested infra: start with 4 A100s, 10 inference workers, batch window 10ms (tune to 12ms during bursts). KV TTL 45s initially.

nina: Security tasks: I'll draft the questionnaire response. Confirmed: KMS-managed keys, TLS everywhere, encryption at rest, option for private control plane. They want logs retention <30d and PII redaction before any exports. I'll attach SOC2 report snippets and a short network diagram.

lena: Great. Finance will want cost examples. Can someone give a rough run-rate for 1M output tokens for the setup (with caching and quantization assumptions)?

finance-bot: estimate: baseline (no cache) ~ $10/1M output tokens. With prefix KV caching and batching expect 15-25% lower token burn, effective range $7.5 - $8.5/1M. Reserved capacity (monthly commit) discount ~20% off on-demand compute pricing.

drew: Initial smoke (5m) running now on cluster red-halcyon-poc-1. ops-bot queued harness image.

ops-bot: infra-bot: cluster red-halcyon-poc-1 provisioned (4xA100). bench-harness tag v2 queued.

kevin: Smoke results (first 5m): sustained 600 qps -> p95 46ms, p50 16ms. During a 30s synthetic 1k qps spike p99 jumped to 230ms and we observed transient 502s (queue overflows). Tunables: increase batch window to 12ms for bursts, bump KV TTL to 60s, and enable conservative fallback route to smaller model under overload.

drew: I'm going to run the full soak + three main runs after applying the tunables. ETA for full runs: ~tomorrow morning. I'll collect flame traces + kernel-level timings.

nina: Security Q&A ETA: EOD today for the draft. Will include: KMS architecture, SOC2 snapshot, log export policy, redaction workflow, network diagram.

lena: Action list:
1) apply burst tuning + run 3x full tests (kevin/drew) - ETA: next day morning
2) exports: perf dashboards + kernel traces (drew) - ETA: with run artifacts
3) security questionnaire draft (nina) - ETA: EOD today
4) pricing comparison (lena + finance-bot) - ETA: 48h

kevin: Tuning notes to commit to runbook: bump batch window to 12ms during burst windows, KV TTL 60s, conservative fallback model configured, throttle token emission on overloaded workers, keep retry budget small to avoid cascading backlog.

lena: Perfect. I'll send Halcyon a tentative calendar: 90m soak then three 10m sustained runs with bursts. Need to confirm dates with them.

drew: One heads-up for the writeup: if they insist on HSM-backed KMS we should include expected lead time for that integration (2-3 weeks). Also reserve option for a 3-day paid dedicated runway if they want accelerated results.

kevin: After the full runs I'll produce a short writeup with summary table: average p95, median batch size, token cost estimate under three scenarios (no cache / prefix cache / prefix+response cache).

ops-bot: bench-bot: scheduled benchmark job id=halcyon-2026-03-22-01 at 2026-03-22T09:00Z.

lena: Thanks team. @nina please attach SOC2 excerpt and the network diagram to the draft reply. We'll couple the perf report + price sensitivity and send as a single packet. :rocket:
